summary: Backend-only tests for the new profile-extractor catalog export endpoints (JSON + ZIP). Seeded 2 test users (A/B) with sessions in test_database; saved 2 profiles for A with duplicate display_names to also exercise filename dedup; user B kept empty for empty-catalog assertions. All 15 tests pass on the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1111 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules (profiles, extractor, xmp) for maintainability. Not a bug, but flagged per code-review guidelines.

/api/profile-extractor/export/zip returns HTTPException 400 for empty catalog — good. /export/json returns 200 with [] — acceptable per spec and matches the front-end's conditional button visibility (buttons only appear when catalog has items).

Filename dedup in export_profiles_zip uses a counter keyed by sanitized base name — correctly prevents ZIP entry overwrites (verified: two profiles with the same display_name produce base.xmp and base_2.xmp).

_profile_to_xmp escapes double-quotes in name/make/model by replacing with single quotes — reasonable minimal escaping; consider full XML entity escaping (& < >) if user-supplied names can contain those chars.
Good: JSON export projection excludes both _id and user_id ({'_id': 0, 'user_id': 0}); confirmed no leakage in response bodies.
test_credentials: Emergent Google Auth session-based. Two ephemeral users+sessions seeded in test_database (TOKEN_A / TOKEN_B env vars). Cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 users + 2 sessions + 2 extracted_profiles (TEST_ prefixed, same display_name, different make/model to bypass save-dedup and hit filename-dedup). Cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_profile_export.py needs TOKEN_A/TOKEN_B env vars (seed via /app/memory/test_credentials.md snippet) and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Run with `-n 0` (single worker) — the two exporting test classes depend on TestSeedUserA running first; xdist loadscope splits classes across workers and races the seed. TestRegression.test_delete_profile_still_works performs cleanup of the TEST_ profiles it inserted.

verified_behavior.auth: 401 without/with bad Bearer on both /export/json and /export/zip.
verified_behavior.json_export: 200, content-type application/json, Content-Disposition attachment filename=catalogo_perfiles.json, body is JSON array, no user_id/_id leaked, scoped per user.
verified_behavior.zip_export: 200, application/zip, filename=catalogo_perfiles_xmp.zip; every entry .xmp; duplicate display_names -> unique filenames (base.xmp + base_2.xmp); valid crs XMP with crs:Name; crs:CameraProfile present for profile_type=camera_profile; tiff:Make/Model present when provided; scoped per user.
